        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G

        for r,c in cells: out[r+shift][c]=g[r][c]

        nrr=nr               # row above new top
    out[nr]=[8]*W
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    lr=lc=None; orient=None
    for r in range(H):
        if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg: lr=r; orient='h'; break
    for c in range(W):
        if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg: lc=c; orient='v'; break
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and (orient=='h' and r!=lr) or (orient=='v' and c!=lc)]
    cells=[(r,c) for r,c in cells if (orient=='h' and r!=lr) or (orient=='v' and c!=lc)]
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    mn,mx=min(rs),max(rs); la,lb=min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # set original shape cells to bg
    for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=bg
    if orient=='v':
        shift=(lc-1-mx)
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c+shift]=g[r][c]
        nleft=la+shift; nright=mx+shift
        e1=nleft-1; e2=nright+1
        nr=e1 if e1>=0 else e2  # side away from line
    else:
        shift=(lr+1-mx)   # move down until bottom touches line
        for r,c in cells: out[r+shift][c]=g[r][c]
        nt=max(rs)+shift; nb=min(rs)+shift
        # side away from line = up
        nr=nb-1
    if nr is not None: out[nr]=[8]*W
    return out

for i in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    a=G[i+' input']; b=G[i+' output']
    ok=f(a)==b
    print(i, ok)
out=f(G['Test input'])
for r in out: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
print(json.dumps(out))
